inputs.original_text: Revelation was included in lawsuit challenging practice of targeting people seeking to gain legal status as they leave immigration courts Sign up for the Breaking News US email to get newsletter alerts in your inbox Lawyers for ICE provided false information to justify arresting and detaining thousands of people who had attended immigration courts, according to newly filed court documents. Federal prosecutors said that lawyers for ICE acknowledged that an agency memo from May of last year gave no authorization for the arrests, court documents show , despite previously citing it to justify the arrests. Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text:
Well, folks, it is plain as day what is happening to our great nation. We are watching the deep state and progressive activist apparatus bend over backwards to undermine our borders and handcuff the very people tasked with upholding our laws. 

Look at the facts we are dealing with here. Federal ICE lawyers had to deal with an agency memo from May of last year that supposedly gave no authorization for the arrests, yet thousands of individuals who shouldn't even be here in the first place were being processed. And how do the leftists respond? Now the left-wing lawyers and open-borders activists are running to court, whining about due process and demanding radical institutional reform of the very agencies trying to protect our nation's sovereignty. 

They want you to believe this is some sort of predatory deceit, but let’s be honest about what’s really going on: our immigration enforcement officers are just trying to do their jobs and maintain basic law and order, while activist judges and entrenched bureaucrats tie their hands. If we don't have borders and we don't enforce the law, we don't have a country. It’s time to stop apologizing for law enforcement and start putting the safety of American citizens first.
